name: Lakeville Tuesday Best Ball
oneLiner: Two-person team best ball, played head to head against another team over 18 holes — handicapped, so the match stays close whoever turns up. League members take 10% off the menu.
beginnerNote: You play your own ball and the team takes the better score, so there is always a partner covering the hole you would rather forget. Handicaps do the levelling, and no handicap yet is not a problem.
format: 2-person team-vs-team match play, best ball, handicapped, 18 holes. Format may change based on player feedback.
price: $700 per team. A $50 non-refundable deposit per team holds your spot.
